correctness.rationale: A direct quadratic Gauss period expansion yields K=I/2-J/(2p)+iE/(2sqrt(p)). Inversion gives E1=0, multiplicative H-characters diagonalize E with pure-imaginary eigenvalues J_chi and conjugate sign reversal. Parseval proves exact centered moment, Rayleigh quotients give sharp optimizing character spaces, Tao 2003 proves eigenvalues avoid 0 and 1, and cyclotomic irreducibility rules out J_chi=0 when m is prime. Uniform proof handles p=3 and all other stated prime cases. Actual extracted checker passes finite cases but is not substituted for the proof.
